title: Home - Buy Local NZ - Free Online Profiles for Kiwi Businesses

facts.fact: Buy Local NZ states that joining its online business community is free and that a free online business profile is offered in each local community.
facts.quote: Free to join, it’s the ultimate digital community platform to showcase and grow your local business

facts.fact: Buy Local NZ's homepage describes its free profile offer with the call to action 'Get My Free Profile'.
facts.quote: Buy Local NZ offers free online business profiles in your local community.

facts.fact: Buy Local NZ states that a free profile gives a business a local business 'Citation' that it says will help boost search results and A.I. Search rankings; no measured result is given.
facts.quote: When you sign up for a free profile, you gain a local business “Citation”, which will help boost you in search results and in A.I. Search.

facts.fact: Buy Local NZ's homepage uses an illustrative hypothetical, not a sourced survey, stating that nine out of ten passersby in a busy neighbourhood never enter a business because they do not know it exists.
facts.quote: nine out of ten passersby never step inside because they don’t even know you exist.
